title: Sort your books three different ways
description: Your bookshelf is a puzzle. Take your books out and sort them three different ways — by colour, by size, and by how much you love them. Which way looks best?
author: SparkKindly · AI-assisted

body.heading: Way one and way two
paragraphs: First, sort by colour: all the red books together, all the blue, all the green. Stand them in a row and you have made a rainbow shelf.
Now mix them up and sort by size instead: tallest books at one end, tiniest at the other, like a staircase going down. Count how many books are in your biggest group each time.

body.heading: Way three: your favourites
paragraphs: Last, sort by love: your most-read, most-loved books at the front where you can grab them, and the forgotten ones behind. You might find a book you have not read for ages — that is the treasure of this game.
Choose your favourite sorting to keep, and put the books away that way with your grown-up. Your shelf, your system.

takeaway: Sort your books by colour, then by size, then by how much you love them — and keep your favourite system on the shelf.
materials: A clear floor or bed to sort on
supervision: A grown-up helps with heavy armfuls of books and joins the choosing of the final system.
safetyNotes: Carry only a few books at a time so none drop on toes.
Stack books flat and steady — no towers that can topple.
screenFreeExtension: Draw your bookshelf with the books in their new order, and colour the spines to match.
